title: Live progress detection misses raw tool-call explanations
reasoning: The overlay entry builder treats a raw assistant tool-call with explanation arguments as live progress by deriving tool-explanation entries from it, but hasCurrentTurnLiveProgressMessages only returns true for messages that are already typed as tool-explanation or search-source. For the same current-turn raw tool-call input, one API reports renderable progress while the boolean helper reports none, which can desynchronize UI decisions that depend on the boolean.
reproduction: Pass messages containing a last user message followed by an assistant tool-call with modelFacingToolCall.arguments.explanation. buildCurrentTurnResponseOverlayEntries produces a tool-explanation entry, while hasCurrentTurnLiveProgressMessages returns false because the source message type remains tool-call.
recommendation: Make hasCurrentTurnLiveProgressMessages use the same derivation rule as the overlay builder, for example by returning true when a current-turn tool-call has collectToolExplanationTexts(message).length > 0.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests are included for the presentation pipeline helpers, and the excerpt shows two related helpers with inconsistent criteria.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a test covering a current-turn raw tool-call with an explanation and assert both overlay entries are produced and live progress detection is true.
minimumFixScope: Change hasCurrentTurnLiveProgressMessages in messagePresentationPipeline.js and add a focused pipeline test.
